source.stem: Which statement about the properties and uses of copper is correct?

options.text: It is used in electrical wiring, and it is ductile.
It is mixed with tin to make the alloy brass.
It is used in overhead electrical cables because it has a low density.
It is used in takeaway food containers because of its resistance to corrosion.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: hydrosphere is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Damage to one Earth system can affect the others, so protection must consider connected systems.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: reduced damage to connected Earth systems -> better protection for life on Earth happens first, and that produces responsible individual, community, and global actions.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Damage to one Earth system can affect the others, so protection must consider connected systems is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Because Earth's hydrosphere, biosphere, atmosphere, and geosphere are connected, protecting life requires cutting greenhouse gases and pollution, protecting biodiversity, using cleaner energy, and making responsible choices such as reusing, repairing, recycling, and saving energy and water. responsible individual, community, and global actions -> reduced damage to connected Earth systems -> better protection for life on Earth The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Because Earth's hydrosphere, biosphere, atmosphere, and geosphere are connected, protecting life requires cutting greenhouse gases and pollution, protecting biodiversity, using cleaner energy, and making responsible choices such as reusing, repairing, recycling, and saving energy and water. One visible action, such as recycling plastic, is enough to protect all life-supporting systems on Earth.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Why Earth supports life. The student must decide: Decide why protecting life on Earth requires connected actions rather than one isolated fix. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names.
